summary: Targeted re-review recovered the missing ALA-A2 activity/toxicity records from primary source text, matched the DRAMP A549/HT29 target values, checked the supplementary PDF text, and converted the placeholder adjudication into a source-reviewed accepted-with-cautions decision.
adjudication_summary: The prior blocking ticket is closed with cautions: primary evidence supports ALA-A2 anticancer activity against A549 and HT29, dose-response estimates, and low hemolysis at 200 uM; DRAMP's antimicrobial label remains a preserved database conflict because no local primary antimicrobial assay was found.

source_review_depth.notes: Review reopened packet and paper-local XML/PDF/supplement/database rows listed in handoff_context.json.

materials_exhausted.note: No blocking material gap remains for the targeted ALA-A2 activity/database adjudication. Non-hit Figure 3c bar values are not text-resolved but are nonblocking.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: ALA-A2 sequence, citation, and A549/HT29 anticancer target text are source matched. DRAMP's antimicrobial activity label and incomplete assay metadata remain preserved source_conflict cautions, not blockers.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Recovered two 200 uM cell-viability rows, two IC50-style dose-response rows, and one human RBC hemolysis row with raw values, units, targets, assay context, and source locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Source-reviewed mechanism claims support cell penetration/no gross membranolysis and autophagy-mediated cell death while keeping the exact intracellular target unresolved.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP labels ALA-A2 as antimicrobial plus anticancer, but the local primary paper materials support anticancer testing only.
Linked DRAMP experiment row has target text but no assay_type/unit/measure fields; primary source rows provide the assay context.

Exact numeric Figure 3c bars for K562, MDA-MB-231, and SH-SY5Y were not present in XML/PDF/supplement/database text. This is nonblocking because the source text gives the hit/non-hit conclusion and exact A549/HT29 values.
Primary paper supports autophagy-mediated cell death and pathway context but states that exact intracellular targets need further work.

Exact numeric bar heights for the non-hit K562, MDA-MB-231, and SH-SY5Y Figure 3c bars are not present in local XML, extracted PDF text, supplementary text, or linked database rows.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking for this targeted repair: the missing exact non-hit bar values do not affect the DRAMP A549/HT29 reconciliation or the core ALA-A2 activity/toxicity records.
